content: धीरता, -धीरत्वम् .²1 Fortitude, courage, strength of mind; विपत्तौ च महाँल्लोके धीरतामनुगच्छति <ls>H. 3. 37</ls>; <ls>V. 2</ls>. .²2 Suppression of jealousy <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Gravity, solemnity (as shown by silence <ab>&c.</ab>); प्रत्यादेशान्न खलु भवतो धीरतां कल्पयामि <ls>Me. 116</ls>. .²4 Steadiness, firmness. .²5 Wisdom, cleverness. .²6 Refusal. (For other meanings see धैर्य.)
